## Summary
- Adds the missing `PATCH /api/live-events/[eventId]` route so live event metadata edits and team update posts persist to the database.
- Introduces a `LiveEventUpdate` model and migration for update history with author attribution.
- Loads persisted updates in the dashboard data loader instead of hardcoding an empty array.

Closes #81

## Test plan
- [x] `pnpm test tests/live-events-patch.test.ts`
- [x] `pnpm test` (108 tests)
- [ ] Manual: operator edits event name/description/briefing and confirms values survive refresh
- [ ] Manual: operator posts a team update and confirms it appears after refresh
- [ ] Manual: non-operator receives 403
- [ ] Run `pnpm db:deploy` before deploying

## Notes
- No `src/App.tsx` changes in this PR to avoid conflict with PR #86; optimistic UI rollback on failed PATCH remains tracked in #83.
- Status lifecycle transitions (pause/end/cancel) remain out of scope for #18.

Made with [Cursor](https://cursor.com)
title: Fix #81: Add PATCH /api/live-events/[eventId]

## Summary
- Adds typed Leantime RPC errors with method names, correlation IDs, and safe log fields.
- Hardens `rpc()` with `AbortController` timeouts, JSON-RPC envelope validation, and bounded exponential backoff retries.
- Returns degraded `fetchLeantimeTasks()` results with `errorKind` / `correlationId` so outages are distinguishable from empty data.
- Maps Leantime failures to 502/503 in API routes via `handleApiError`.

Closes #48

## Test plan
- [x] `pnpm test tests/leantime-client.test.ts`
- [x] `pnpm test` (110 tests)
- [ ] Manual: dashboard task list shows degraded state when Leantime is unreachable
- [ ] Manual: task create/update surfaces integration error instead of hanging
title: Fix #48: Add Leantime timeouts, typed errors, and bounded retries

## Summary
- Hardens `POST /api/onboarding/complete` with Discord-primary onboarding: verified Discord users can complete onboarding without a token; optional invite links are consumed atomically when supplied.
- Blocks re-onboarding for already verified/active users and forces all self-selected section memberships to `member` role.
- Aligns onboarding UI: auth gates run before hash invite routes, bad invites fall back to Discord-primary flow, and section payload matches schema.
- Documents the policy in README and data-model docs; adds route tests for missing token, invite races, invalid tokens, existing members, and section selection.

Closes #51

## Test plan
- [x] `pnpm test tests/onboarding-complete.test.ts`
- [x] `pnpm test` (111 tests)
- [ ] Manual: Discord-verified pending user completes onboarding without token
- [ ] Manual: used/invalid invite token returns 409 with no user mutation
- [ ] Manual: two parallel tabs on same open invite ΓÇö only one succeeds
- [ ] Manual: already-onboarded user re-submit returns 409

title: Fix #51: Enforce Discord-primary onboarding policy
